name: 新金路
current_thesis: Loss-making chlor-alkali cyclical asset with caustic soda profit support and low-confidence mining optionality; current price already exceeds conservative fair value, so no fresh capital before price falls into the buy zone and cash-flow evidence improves.

position_plan.condition: 2026-07-10 price near 19.68 CNY and fundamentals still loss-making
position_plan.reason: Current market value prices in optimistic mining optionality while PVC remains loss-making and Q1 2026 cash flow is negative.

position_plan.condition: price falls into 5.0-6.8 CNY and PVC spread, caustic soda pricing, and cash flow stop deteriorating
position_plan.reason: Only a small tracking position is justified before mining projects produce auditable profit.

position_plan.condition: two consecutive quarters of positive recurring profit and operating cash flow plus verified Limumu/Limu mining project progress
position_plan.reason: Position size can rise only after chemical cycle recovery and mineral optionality become financial statement evidence.

price_triggers.reason: Enter buy-zone review; reassess PVC spread, caustic soda price, debt, and mining project milestones before any first position.
Valuation exceeds conservative fair value; reduce or avoid unless audited earnings inflect materially.
High-risk overvaluation zone for a loss-making cyclical chemical asset; only mineral option speculation can justify it.

review_triggers.reason: Review after the 2026 interim report to verify Q2 profit, cash flow, debt, and project progress.
Review after the 2026 third-quarter report for recurring profit and operating cash flow trend.

key_tracking_metrics: PVC spot price and calcium-carbide-route PVC gross spread
Caustic soda 32% and 50% liquid alkali prices
Calcium carbide, semi-coke, and Sichuan power purchase cost
PVC capacity utilization versus 2025 level of 54.68%
Caustic soda product gross margin versus 2025 level of 59.04%
Operating cash flow and restricted cash
Limu/Limumu mining 600ktpa mining upgrade and 1500ktpa beneficiation milestones
Environmental, safety, and hazardous-chemical license renewals
Controlling shareholder and Sichuan Jinhaima share pledge changes
